notes: Draft only. verified false means the comment or review text has not been fetched or checked. relevantSourceIds stays null until a person lists every stored row that supports the answer. Several comments may all be relevant. A parent snapshot id is not evidence. A completed review fetch with zero records creates no review source id and does not prove that no review activity ever occurred. not_fetched and incomplete_bounded stay unverified. This set does not measure general retrieval quality.

fetchLimits.scope: Each issue comment collection, each pull-request conversation collection, and each pull-request review collection stops on its own after two pages.
fetchLimits.complete: The pagination response offers no next page, including a finished page with zero records. A full page is complete only when no next page is offered.
fetchLimits.incompleteBounded: The two-page cap was reached while the pagination response still offered a next page. The stored rows are a prefix, not the collection.
fetchLimits.notFetched: The collection was not requested, or the call stopped on HTTP 403 or 429. Do not store that as zero records.
